parameters.text: =Workers Teleported to task location and tasks assigned.

tactics: Equip best available melee weapon from inventory (sword > axe > fists) using a safe equipment check:
const weapon = bot.inventory.items().find(i => i.name.includes('sword')) || bot.inventory.items().find(i => i.name.includes('axe')) || null; if (weapon) { await bot.equip(weapon, 'hand'); }
Combat loop (group clear):
While bot.health >= 12:
let target = Object.values(bot.entities).find(e => e.name === 'cow' && e.position.distanceTo(bot.entity.position) < 20);
If no target is found, break the loop.
While target && target.isValid && bot.health >= 12:
await bot.lookAt(target.position);
await bot.attack(target);
await skills.wait(bot, 300);
target = bot.entities[target.id];
Maintain a general left/front position relative to the cows; avoid clustering directly with Soldier2.
If you come within 3 blocks of Soldier2, briefly reposition using await skills.moveAway(bot, 3) before re-engaging.
If bot.health < 12 (6 hearts), retreat: await skills.moveAway(bot, 10); await skills.stay(bot, -1); then stop combat.
If any cow you are chasing moves more than 20 blocks from the rally point, disengage from that target and return to rally with skills.stay(bot, -1).
After no cows remain within 20 blocks, hold position near the rally point with skills.stay(bot, -1).
Soldier1.position: Front/left side of the cow group relative to the rally point.
Soldier1.objective: Engage and kill cows near Mauri67 from one side, clearing targets one by one.
constraints: Do NOT use bot.pathfinder, GoalNear, GoalBlock, GoalFollow, or bot.navigate.
Use only bot.lookAt(target.position), bot.attack(target), skills.moveAway, skills.wait, and skills.stay.
Maintain at least 3 blocks spacing from Soldier2 when possible.
Do not pursue any target beyond 20 blocks from the rally point.
Always ensure target && target.isValid before each attack iteration.
Never attack player Mauri67 or any other player.
Soldier1.retreatCondition: health below 6 hearts (bot.health < 12) or active target moves beyond 20 blocks from rally point
Soldier1.targetAssignment: Continuously target the nearest cow within 20 blocks near player Mauri67. Never attack player Mauri67 or other players.

tactics: Equip best available melee weapon (sword > axe > fists) using safe equipment logic:
const weapon = bot.inventory.items().find(i => i.name.includes('sword')) || bot.inventory.items().find(i => i.name.includes('axe')) || null; if (weapon) { await bot.equip(weapon, 'hand'); }
Wait briefly for Soldier1 to start engaging: await skills.wait(bot, 1000);
Combat loop (group clear):

let target = Object.values(bot.entities).find(e => e.name === 'cow' && e.position.distanceTo(bot.entity.position) < 20);
If no target is found, break the loop.
While target && target.isValid && bot.health >= 16:
await bot.lookAt(target.position);
await bot.attack(target);
await skills.wait(bot, 300);
target = bot.entities[target.id];
Maintain a right/flanking angle relative to Soldier1 and the cows, avoiding overlap.
If within 3 blocks of Soldier1, use await skills.moveAway(bot, 3) to restore spacing before resuming attacks.
If bot.health < 16 (8 hearts) OR Soldier1 retreats, disengage: await skills.moveAway(bot, 10); await skills.stay(bot, -1).
If any cow you are chasing moves beyond 20 blocks from the rally point, break pursuit and return to rally with skills.stay(bot, -1).
After no cows remain within 20 blocks, stop attacking and remain near the rally point using skills.stay(bot, -1).
Soldier2.position: Front/right or opposite side of the cow group relative to the rally point.
Soldier2.objective: Engage and kill cows from the opposite side of Soldier1 to speed up group clearing.
constraints: Do NOT use bot.pathfinder, GoalNear, GoalBlock, GoalFollow, or bot.navigate.
Use only bot.lookAt(target.position), bot.attack(target), skills.moveAway, skills.wait, and skills.stay.
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from Soldier1 during combat when feasible.
Do not pursue any target beyond 20 blocks from the rally point.
Always verify target && target.isValid before each attack.
Never attack player Mauri67 or any other player.
Soldier2.retreatCondition: health below 8 hearts (bot.health < 16) or Soldier1 retreats or active target moves beyond 20 blocks from rally point
